content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: On the purchase order:new screen, the Save button gives no visible response after a click, so users click it again; Save was clicked at events 415, 417 and then 422 with no navigation or error event between them.", "fix": "Fix: On the purchase order:new screen, change the Save button so that it shows a disabled or busy state and a visible saved confirmation immediately on click, so a second click is not needed.", "cited_event_ids": ["415", "417", "422"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["Whether the Save request succeeded or failed is not in the events.", "The meaning of the overlay shown/removed coverage events is not stated, so they are not treated as a UI loading state.", "The absence of visible change after Save is taken from the insight facts; the events do not show the screen state directly."]}
